comment:
* Generator for X.509 extensions
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public void addExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid, boolean critical, ASN1Encodable value) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Add an extension with the given oid and the passed in value to be included
     * in the OCTET STRING associated with the extension.
     *
     * @param oid  OID for the extension.
     * @param critical  true if critical, false otherwise.
     * @param value the ASN.1 object to be included in the extension.

methods.name: public void addExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid, boolean critical, byte[] value)
methods.comment:
* Add an extension with the given oid and the passed in byte array to be wrapped in the
     * OCTET STRING associated with the extension.
     *
     * @param oid OID for the extension.
     * @param critical true if critical, false otherwise.
     * @param value the byte array to be wrapped.

methods.name: public void addExtension(Extension extension)
methods.comment:
* Add a given extension.
     *
     * @param extension the full extension value.

methods.name: public void replaceExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid, boolean critical, ASN1Encodable value) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Replace an extension with the given oid and the passed in value to be included
     * in the OCTET STRING associated with the extension.
     *
     * @param oid  OID for the extension.
     * @param critical  true if critical, false otherwise.
     * @param value the ASN.1 object to be included in the extension.

methods.name: public void replaceExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid, boolean critical, byte[] value)
methods.comment:
* Replace an extension with the given oid and the passed in byte array to be wrapped in the
     * OCTET STRING associated with the extension.
     *
     * @param oid OID for the extension.
     * @param critical true if critical, false otherwise.
     * @param value the byte array to be wrapped.

methods.name: public void replaceExtension(Extension extension)
methods.comment:
* Replace a given extension.
     *
     * @param extension the full extension value.

methods.name: public void removeExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid)
methods.comment:
* Remove a given extension.
     *
     * @param oid OID for the extension to remove.

methods.name: public boolean hasExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid)
methods.comment:
* Return if the extension indicated by OID is present.
     *
     * @param oid the OID for the extension of interest.
     * @return the Extension, or null if it is not present.

methods.name: public Extension getExtension(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid)
methods.comment:
* Return the current value of the extension for OID.
     *
     * @param oid the OID for the extension we want to fetch.
     * @return true if a matching extension is present, false otherwise.

methods.name: public boolean isEmpty()
methods.comment:
* Return true if there are no extension present in this generator.
     *
     * @return true if empty, false otherwise

methods.name: public Extensions generate()
methods.comment:
* Generate an Extensions object based on the current state of the generator.
     *
     * @return  an X09Extensions object.
